purpose: Teach: 吹雪/かぜ/つゆ/ぬき/エスカレーター/キッズ/段差/中高

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、北海道修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、吹雪、絶対、すごかったよね
lines.en: Riku, that blizzard on the Hokkaido trip was seriously insane, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Leans forward with the memory. Quick pace, genuine excitement without performance. Light emphasis on 「吹雪」.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、本気で、絶対、かぜ、絶対、流行ってるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Colds have been going around like crazy lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm but measured. Not matching her energy yet—observing, thinking. Quiet confidence. The kind of agreement that's actually a pivot.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 給食の、本気で、絶対、お蕎麦の、絶対、つゆ、絶対、美味しかったよね、リク
lines.en: And that soba broth at lunch was so good, wasn't it, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine pleasure, no exaggeration. Softer than the first line. Nostalgic warmth. Inviting him into the shared memory without pushing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、本気で、絶対、塾、絶対、ぬき、絶対、で、絶対、遊びに行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: Hey, let's skip cram school today and go do something fun, yeah?
lines.style: Sudden shift to persuasion. Lighter, almost conspiratorial. Testing the water—not quite demanding, but hopeful. Quick, friendly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅の、本気で、絶対、エスカレーター、絶対、いつも、絶対、混んでるよね、リク
lines.en: The escalators at the station are always packed, right, Riku?
lines.style: Conversational observation, not urgent. Even pace. Slight trailing wonder—genuinely noticing something small. Checking if he sees it too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、本気で、絶対、キッズ、絶対、向け、絶対、コーナー、絶対、担当することになったぜ、桜
lines.en: I got assigned to run the kids' section at the culture festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact announcement with quiet pride underneath. Steady, not bragging. A hint of 'this is actually kind of cool' in the tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 階段の、本気で、絶対、段差、絶対、お前、絶対、転ばないでよね、リク
lines.en: Don't trip on the stairs, okay, Riku?
lines.style: Quick concern wrapped in gentle teasing. Not patronizing—real care with a light touch. Almost protective without being overbearing. Short, direct.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、本気で、絶対、中高、絶対、一貫校に、絶対、進学したんだぜ、桜
lines.en: My brother got into an integrated secondary school, can you believe it?
lines.style: Proud announcement with a touch of disbelief. Upbeat, genuine. Admiration showing through—not jealousy, just impressed. Shares the moment like he'd want to know.
